card.name: Capital B starting a new term
card.fires_on: A capital B (or short opening letters like Rec or Al) that begins a new term right after a sentence break, heading or parenthesis. It is often in all-caps warnings, where BLOOD or Bile follows.

modes.label: Names and beneficiary
modes.description: B begins a name or the word beneficiary in general web text.

card.writes: It pushes word-ending pieces and foreign name endings, and pushes down donor and recipient words.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a new term, often a capital B in BLOOD, Bile or a name.
